# Baked potato

<a href="Item-baked-potato.md" title="Baked potato"><img src="icons/31.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Baked potato"></a>

Cooked food that restores **5 food points**, compared with 1 for a raw potato. Baked potatoes cannot be planted.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 64 |
| Food restored | 5 points |
